answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond tied to a verifiable work history, like an atlas of past tasks signed by distinct peers, before it can claim rewards. A sybil farmer would need to fund and maintain many separate histories, and crossing a canyon of checks — unique device attestation, proof of useful work, and slow reputation growth — makes each fake identity costly in time and capital. An umber flag on sudden bursts of new accounts lets peers pause attestation until the history checks out.
